title: Create /blog index page with post grid, category filter, and featured post section
description: Build a /blog landing page displaying all blog posts from TypeScript data source with category/tag filtering via URL query params and a featured post highlight at the top.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /blog renders all blog posts sorted by publishedDate descending in grid format with thumbnail, title, excerpt, date, and category badge
Category filter buttons update URL (?category=transport) and re-render filtered post list without full page reload
Featured post section highlights one manually selected post with larger card and 'Featured' badge
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/blog/page.tsx (route segment page component with searchParams for category filter)
File to edit: site/src/data/blog-posts.ts (ensure blogPosts array has category, tags, publishedDate, excerpt fields)
Component to create: site/src/components/BlogPostCard.tsx (reusable card showing post preview with image, title, date)
Test command: uv run vitest site/src/app/blog/page.test.tsx --run

title: Add BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema to all blog post pages
description: Implement BreadcrumbList structured data on each blog post page (e.g., Home > Blog > Transport > Post Title) to improve SERP appearance and internal linking signals.
acceptanceCriteria: Each blog post page generates BreadcrumbList JSON-LD in <head> with 4-5 items: Home, /blog, /blog/[category], and current post title with correct itemListElement positions
BreadcrumbList schema validates successfully with Google Structured Data Tester at https://search.google.com/structured-data/testing-tool
generateMetadata() in [slug]/page.tsx includes breadcrumb information in structured data
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/lib/schema-utils.ts (export generateBreadcrumbListSchema function that takes category, slug, title and returns JSON-LD object)
File to edit: site/src/app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx (call schema utility in generateMetadata and render <BreadcrumbSchema> component)
Component to create: site/src/components/BreadcrumbSchema.tsx (renders <script type='application/ld+json'> tag with breadcrumb data)
Test command: rtk next build && curl http://localhost:3000/blog/getting-around-jb | grep -A 15 'BreadcrumbList'

title: Build JB News & Updates widget on homepage with curated RSS feed sources
description: Create a homepage widget that fetches and displays 5 latest news headlines from curated JB/Malaysia news RSS feeds using ISR caching with graceful error handling and fallback UI.
acceptanceCriteria: Widget displays max 5 latest news items with headline (truncated to 80 chars), source name, published date, and link to original article
RSS feed URLs configured in site/src/config/news-feeds.ts as array of {label, feedUrl, color?} objects (e.g., Malaysiakini, NST, Berita Harian)
Widget uses ISR with revalidate: 3600 and shows error boundary placeholder if feed fetch fails after 5 second timeout
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/components/NewsWidget.tsx (async Server Component using feed-parser or rss library to parse RSS XML)
File to create: site/src/config/news-feeds.ts (export newsFeedSources array with {label, feedUrl, icon} objects)
File to edit: site/src/app/page.tsx (import NewsWidget and render in hero or below fold section)
Dependency: add 'feed' npm package: npm install feed rss-parser
Test command: uv run vitest site/src/components/NewsWidget.test.tsx --run

title: Create dynamic blog category and tag archive pages at /blog/[category] and /blog/tag/[tag]
description: Implement dynamic route pages that filter blog posts by category or tag with unique meta titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, and BreadcrumbList schema per archive.
acceptanceCriteria: /blog/transport displays all posts with category='transport' with og:title='Transport & Getting Around — JB Backpacker Blog' and meta description matching category theme
/blog/tag/budget displays all posts with tags including 'budget', with canonical URL /blog/tag/budget and 301 redirects from legacy ?tag=budget query params
Each category/tag page generates BreadcrumbList with 5 items ending in category/tag name and includes proper breadcrumb navigation UI
technicalNotes: File to create: site/src/app/blog/[category]/page.tsx (dynamic segment; use params.category to filter blogPosts array with post.category === category)
File to create: site/src/app/blog/tag/[tag]/page.tsx (separate dynamic segment; filter with post.tags.includes(tag))
File to edit: site/src/data/blog-posts.ts (ensure all posts have category string and tags: string[] array)
Each page file includes generateMetadata() with dynamic og:title, description, canonical URL, and robots: {index: true}
Test command: rtk next build && curl 'http://localhost:3000/blog/transport' | grep -o '<title>.*</title>'

title: Update sitemap.ts to include all blog post and blog archive URLs with lastmod dates
description: Extend the sitemap.ts configuration to dynamically generate sitemap entries for all blog post routes (/blog/[slug]) and blog archive pages (category/tag) with appropriate priority levels and lastModified timestamps.
acceptanceCriteria: sitemap.ts imports blogPosts array and maps each post to Sitemap entry with url: /blog/{slug}, lastModified: post.updatedDate || post.publishedDate, priority: 0.8
Blog category archive pages included with priority 0.7; blog tag archive pages with priority 0.6
Generated public/sitemap.xml contains at least 15 /blog/* URLs and is valid XML (test with xmllint or browser)
technicalNotes: File to edit: site/src/app/sitemap.ts (add blogPostEntries = blogPosts.map(post => ({...})) and concat with existing routes array)
File to reference: site/src/data/blog-posts.ts (read blogPosts array structure to ensure slug, publishedDate, updatedDate fields exist)
Optional helper: site/src/lib/sitemap-utils.ts (export generateBlogSitemapEntries function to keep sitemap.ts DRY)
Test command: rtk next build && grep -c '/blog/' public/sitemap-0.xml && echo 'Sitemap entries for blog posts created'
